question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

You seem to be __mean__ to your seniors.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mean"** means unkind, spiteful, or unfair; it refers to someone who is unpleasant or malicious in behavior. (मतलब)
 
 
• **Example: **He was being mean to his younger brother by taking away his toys.
 
 
 
• **"Sympathetic"** refers to feeling or showing sympathy and understanding towards others, being compassionate and kind-hearted. (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **She was very sympathetic towards the homeless man and offered him some food.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'mean'** is **'sympathetic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apathetic** (उदासीन): Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
 
 
• **Example:** The student was apathetic about his grades and did not study for exams.
 
 
 
• **Modest** (विनम्र): Having or showing a humble opinion of oneself; not boastful.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his achievements, he remained modest and never bragged about his success.
 
 
 
• **Rude** (अभद्र): Offensively impolite or ill-mannered.
 
 
• **Example:** It was rude of him to interrupt the speaker during the presentation.
